Title: Generally Available: Introducing Azure Databricks Clean Rooms

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks Clean Rooms offers a privacy-safe environment for collaboration on all your data and AI assets, ensuring no direct access to sensitive information. In today’s world, organizations require an open, flexible, and secure way to collaborate on data. Azure Databricks Clean Rooms meets these essential needs, enabling businesses to work seamlessly with their customers and partners across any cloud platform in a privacy-safe manner.

Learn more.
